I am currently implementing issue 73:

<pasted_content id="949d">

## Summary

Add mask-specific transformation behavior that allows users to control how a mask hides or reveals its contents. Existing element transformations such as moving, resizing, and rotating should continue to work normally while preserving the mask relationship with its contents. Also implement a more robust parent-child relationship between the mask and the elements it mask

## User Scenario

A user creates a mask using one of the pre-built stamps and places content inside it. The user can then modify the mask's masking behavior, such as choosing whether the area inside or outside the mask is visible. Normal transformations can still be applied to the mask without breaking its relationship with the contents.

**Reason:** Requires adding masking-specific transformation behavior while preserving the existing element transformation system and mask/content relationship.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Mask behavior can be configured** to determine whether the area inside or outside of the mask is visible.
- [ ] **Changing the mask behavior updates the visible content** without requiring the mask or its contents to be recreated.
- [ ] **Parent-Child Tags** visible when moving mask or adding elements to mask
- [ ] **Mask all or none** option that allows the user to immediately connect or sever all elements on the canvas to a mask.
- [ ] **Element can be tied to multiple mask** which allows a element to be connected to 3 mask. If
- [ ] **Mask behavior remains consistent after multiple transformations**, including combinations of moving, resizing, rotating, and changing the masking mode.

## Out of Scope

- Creating the initial mask functionality.
- Adding new mask shapes or stamps.
- Implementing basic element movement, resizing, or rotation.
- Changing the existing transformation system for non-mask elements.

Subissue for Issue (#11): Implement the ability of Shape Masking with the pre-built stamps. </pasted_content id="949d">

```text
186	/**
187	 * Clips the context to the mask's outline. The context is expected to be in
188	 * scene coordinates offset by (`offsetX`, `offsetY`), e.g. the scroll.
189	 */
190	export const clipToMask = (
191	  context: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
192	  mask: ExcalidrawMaskElement,
193	  offsetX: number,
194	  offsetY: number,
195	) => {
196	  const cx = mask.x + mask.width / 2 + offsetX;
197	  const cy = mask.y + mask.height / 2 + offsetY;
198
199	  context.translate(cx, cy);
200	  context.rotate(mask.angle);
201	  context.translate(-mask.width / 2, -mask.height / 2);
202
203	  context.beginPath();
204	  const outline = getMaskOutline(mask);
205	  if (outline.type === "rect") {
206	    if (outline.radius && context.roundRect) {
207	      context.roundRect(0, 0, outline.width, outline.height, outline.radius);
208	    } else {
209	      context.rect(0, 0, outline.width, outline.height);
210	    }
211	  } else if (outline.type === "ellipse") {
212	    context.ellipse(
213	      outline.width / 2,
214	      outline.height / 2,
215	      outline.width / 2,
216	      outline.height / 2,
217	      0,
218	      0,
219	      Math.PI * 2,
220	    );
221	  } else {
222	    outline.points.forEach(([x, y], index) =>
223	      index ? context.lineTo(x, y) : context.moveTo(x, y),
224	    );
225	    context.closePath();
226	  }
227	  context.clip();
228
229	  context.translate(mask.width / 2, mask.height / 2);
230	  context.rotate(-mask.angle);
231	  context.translate(-cx, -cy);
232	};
233
234	/** SVG path data of the mask's outline, in its local coordinates */
235	export const getMaskSvgPathData = (mask: ExcalidrawMaskElement) => {
236	  const outline = getMaskOutline(mask);
237	  if (outline.type === "rect") {
238	    const { width: w, height: h } = outline;
239	    const r = Math.min(outline.radius, w / 2, h / 2);
240	    if (!r) {
241	      return `M0 0H${w}V${h}H0Z`;
242	    }
243	    return (
244	      `M${r} 0H${w - r}A${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${w} ${r}V${h - r}` +
245	      `A${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${w - r} ${h}H${r}A${r} ${r} 0 0 1 0 ${h - r}` +
246	      `V${r}A${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${r} 0Z`
247	    );
248	  }
249	  if (outline.type === "ellipse") {
250	    const rx = outline.width / 2;
251	    const ry = outline.height / 2;
252	    return (
253	      `M0 ${ry}A${rx} ${ry} 0 1 0 ${outline.width} ${ry}` +
254	      `A${rx} ${ry} 0 1 0 0 ${ry}Z`
255	    );
256	  }
257	  return `${outline.points
258	    .map(([x, y], index) => `${index ? "L" : "M"}${x} ${y}`)
259	    .join("")}Z`;
260	};
261
262	/** SVG transform placing the mask's local outline into scene coordinates */
263	export const getMaskSvgTransform = (
264	  mask: ExcalidrawMaskElement,
265	  offsetX: number,
266	  offsetY: number,
267	) => {
268	  const cx = mask.x + mask.width / 2 + offsetX;
269	  const cy = mask.y + mask.height / 2 + offsetY;
270	  const degrees = (180 * mask.angle) / Math.PI;
271	  return `translate(${cx} ${cy}) rotate(${degrees}) translate(${
272	    -mask.width / 2
273	  } ${-mask.height / 2})`;
274	};
```

```text
2	import {
3	  clipToMask,
4	  getActiveMaskElements,
5	  getBoundTextElement,
6	  getMaskSvgPathData,
7	  getMaskSvgTransform,
8	  renderElement,
9	} from "@excalidraw/element";
10
11	import type {
12	  ElementsMap,
13	  NonDeletedExcalidrawElement,
14	  NonDeletedSceneElementsMap,
15	} from "@excalidraw/element/types";
16
17	import type { RoughCanvas } from "roughjs/bin/canvas";
18
19	import type {
20	  RenderableElementsMap,
21	  StaticCanvasRenderConfig,
22	} from "../scene/types";
23	import type { StaticCanvasAppState } from "../types";
24
25	/** opacity of the masked-out content previewed while the mask is selected */
26	export const MASK_PREVIEW_OPACITY = 0.2;
27
28	/**
29	 * Clips the context to the element's enabled masks (their intersection).
30	 * While one of the masks is selected, the masked-out parts are first drawn
31	 * faintly so the user can see what the masks are hiding.
32	 */
33	export const applyMaskClip = (
34	  element: NonDeletedExcalidrawElement,
35	  elementsMap: RenderableElementsMap,
36	  allElementsMap: NonDeletedSceneElementsMap,
37	  rc: RoughCanvas,
38	  context: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
39	  renderConfig: StaticCanvasRenderConfig,
40	  appState: StaticCanvasAppState,
41	) => {
42	  const masks = getActiveMaskElements(element, allElementsMap);
43	  if (!masks.length) {
44	    return;
45	  }
46
47	  if (
48	    !renderConfig.isExporting &&
49	    masks.some((mask) => appState.selectedElementIds[mask.id])
50	  ) {
51	    const boundTextElement = getBoundTextElement(element, elementsMap);
52	    for (const el of boundTextElement
53	      ? [element, boundTextElement]
54	      : [element]) {
55	      renderElement(
56	        el,
57	        elementsMap,
58	        allElementsMap,
59	        rc,
60	        context,
61	        renderConfig,
62	        appState,
63	        MASK_PREVIEW_OPACITY,
64	      );
65	    }
66	  }
67
68	  // successive clips intersect
69	  for (const mask of masks) {
70	    clipToMask(context, mask, appState.scrollX, appState.scrollY);
71	  }
72	};
73
74	/**
75	 * If the element has enabled masks, appends one `<g>` per mask, each nested
76	 * in the previous and clipped to that mask's outline, to `svgRoot` and
77	 * returns the innermost, so the element can be rendered into it.
78	 */
79	export const createSvgMaskGroup = (
80	  element: NonDeletedExcalidrawElement,
81	  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
82	  svgRoot: SVGElement,
83	  offsetX: number,
84	  offsetY: number,
85	) => {
86	  const masks = getActiveMaskElements(element, elementsMap);
87	  if (!masks.length) {
88	    return null;
89	  }
90
91	  const doc = svgRoot.ownerDocument;
92	  const defs = svgRoot.querySelector("defs") || svgRoot;
93	  let parent: SVGElement = svgRoot;
94	  for (const mask of masks) {
95	    const clipPath = doc.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "clipPath");
96	    clipPath.id = `mask-clipPath-${element.id}-${mask.id}`;
97	    clipPath.setAttribute("clipPathUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
98	    const path = doc.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "path");
99	    path.setAttribute("d", getMaskSvgPathData(mask));
100	    path.setAttribute("transform", getMaskSvgTransform(mask, offsetX, offsetY));
101	    clipPath.appendChild(path);
102	    defs.appendChild(clipPath);
103
104	    const g = doc.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "g");
105	    g.setAttribute("clip-path", `url(#${clipPath.id})`);
106	    parent.appendChild(g);
107	    parent = g;
108	  }
109	  return parent;
110	};
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>

<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**Right now, dragging a mask by itself only moves the clip window. The masked elements stay where they are. For the 'parent-child' relationship in issue 73, what should happen when you drag a mask on its own?**

Options:

- **Children follow (Recommended)** - Dragging a mask also drags all of its masked elements, the same way frames move their children. Resizing and rotating the mask still change only the clip shape.
- **Children follow, with Alt to detach** - Children follow by default. Holding Alt while dragging moves only the mask, so you can reposition the window over the content.
- **Keep current behavior** - The mask moves alone. 'Parent-child' only means the tags and the links.

**The issue text is cut off at 'connected to 3 mask. If'. Elements can already have any number of masks (from #74). Should there be a limit?**

Options:

- **Cap at 3 masks (Recommended)** - An element can have up to 3 masks. Picking a 4th is refused, and the masking-mode bar shows a short message.
- **No cap** - Keep the current unlimited many-to-many behavior. The criterion is already met.

**Where should 'Mask all / Mask none' live, and what should it affect?**

Options:

- **Mask options toolbar (Recommended)** - Two buttons in the mask edit toolbar. 'All' links every element on the canvas that can be masked to this mask. 'None' removes every link to this mask.
- **Toolbar + masking-mode bar** - Same as above, and 'All' is also available in the masking-mode bar while picking.

**When should the parent and child tags (small labels such as 'Mask' on the mask and 'Masked' on its children) be drawn on the canvas?**

Options:

- **Mask selected/dragged/picking (Recommended)** - Shown while a mask is selected, being dragged, or in masking mode, and also when a masked element is selected. Never exported.
- **Always visible** - Shown on all masks and masked elements at all times (still left out of exports).

**Answer:** Keep current behavior, No cap, Toolbar + masking-mode bar, Mask selected/dragged/picking (Recommended)

</details></tool-use>

```markdown
# Issue 73 — Mask transform behavior, parent/child tags, mask all/none

## Context

Issues #11, #72 and #74 already provide the following:

- Many-to-many links: `element.maskIds`.
- Clipping on/off: `mask.maskEnabled`.
- Masking mode ("picking") and the mask options toolbar ("editing").
- Grouping and duplication that keep the links.
- Canvas and SVG clipping in `packages/excalidraw/renderer/maskClip.ts`.

Issue 73 adds four things:

1. A **mask mode**: show the content inside the mask (current behavior) or outside it.
2. **Parent and child tags** drawn on the canvas.
3. **Mask all / Mask none** buttons.
4. Tests that show masks behave the same after any mix of move, resize, rotate and mode changes.

Your decisions:

- **Dragging a mask by itself still moves only the clip window.** "Parent-child" means the links plus the tags; children do not follow the mask.
- **No limit** on how many masks an element can have. #74 already supports several masks per element, so this criterion only needs a test.
- **Mask all / none** goes in the mask options toolbar **and** the masking-mode bar.
- **Tags** show while a mask is selected or being dragged, during masking mode, or when a masked element is selected. They are never exported.

## 1. Mask mode (inside / outside)

**Data:** add `maskMode?: "inside" | "outside"` to the element base type in `packages/element/src/types.ts`, next to `maskEnabled`. `undefined` means `"inside"`, so existing files still work.

- `packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts`: add `maskMode` to the `Omit<…>` list and the optional fields, the same way `maskEnabled` is handled. Keep only valid values; otherwise drop the field.

**Helpers** in `packages/element/src/mask.ts`:

- `getMaskMode(mask)`, returning `mask.maskMode ?? "inside"`.
- `clipToMask(context, mask, offsetX, offsetY, outerExtent?)`: in `"outside"` mode, add a large rectangle around the shape (in the mask's local coordinates) as a second subpath, then call `context.clip("evenodd")`. The shape becomes a hole, so only the content outside it stays visible. Clips stacked one after another still intersect, so several masks with mixed modes work as before.
- `outerExtent`: computed in `applyMaskClip` from `getElementBounds(element)` of the masked element. The value is its farthest corner distance from the mask's center plus the mask's diagonal, so the rectangle always covers the content at any rotation and avoids huge-number precision problems.
- `getMaskSvgPathData(mask, outerExtent?)`: in outside mode, start the path with the outer rectangle. In `createSvgMaskGroup`, set `clip-rule="evenodd"` on the clip `<path>` when the mode is outside.

**Rendering:** in `maskClip.ts`, update `applyMaskClip` and `createSvgMaskGroup` to pass the mode and extent. The faint preview of masked-out content still works unchanged, because it draws the element first and then clips.

**Action:** `actionToggleMaskMode` in `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionMask.tsx`, modeled on `actionToggleMaskEnabled`. It switches the edited mask between `"inside"` and `"outside"` with `CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY`, so it can be undone. It changes only the mask element, never the content, which satisfies "updates without recreating".

**UI:** in `MaskEditToolbar.tsx`, add a two-option toggle labeled "Show: Inside | Outside" (`labels.mask.showInside` / `labels.mask.showOutside`). Use the existing `.mask-edit-toolbar__button` style with an active state.

## 2. Mask all / Mask none

Add both actions to `actionMask.tsx`. Their predicate is that `maskEditor` is set (picking or editing), and both work on `getEditedMask`.

- `actionMaskAll`: add `mask.id` to `maskIds` on every non-deleted element where `canBeMasked(el, mask, elementsMap)` is true. Set `maskEnabled: true` if this is the first link, the same way `actionApplyMask` does. Keep the current `maskEditor` mode and use `getMaskSelectionState(mask)`.
- `actionMaskNone`: `removeMaskLinks(elements, el => isMaskedBy(el, mask.id), mask.id)`. Unlike `actionRemoveMask`, the editor or picking mode **stays open**, so the user can start picking again right away.
- Register both in `actions/index.ts` and `actions/types.ts` (the `ActionName` union).
- Add buttons in two places:
  - `MaskEditToolbar.tsx`, with test ids `mask-all` and `mask-none`.
  - `MaskingModeBar.tsx`, before Cancel, with test ids `masking-mode-all` and `masking-mode-none`.
- Add i18n strings to the `labels.mask` block in `packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json`: `all`, `none`, `showInside`, `showOutside`, `tagMask`, `tagMasked`.

## 3. Parent/child tags (interactive canvas only)

Add a new `renderMaskTags(context, appState, elementsMap)` in `packages/excalidraw/renderer/interactiveScene.ts`, called from `renderInteractiveScene` after the selection borders. The interactive canvas is never exported, so exports stay unchanged.

**Which masks get tags:**

- Selected masks (`isMaskElement`).
- `appState.maskEditor?.maskId`, which covers masking mode and mask options.
- The masks of any selected masked element (`getMaskElements`).

**Tag content:**

- Each relevant mask gets a small pill at its top-left bound: "Mask · N", where N is the number of children (`getMaskedElements(...).length`). An outside-mode mask adds "(outside)".
- Each child of a relevant mask gets a pill labeled "Masked". If the child has more than one mask, the label becomes "Masked ×k".

**Drawing:**

- Use the element's absolute coordinates (`getElementAbsoluteCoords`), drawn in scene space under the existing zoom and scroll transform.
- Scale font size and padding by `1 / zoom` so the pills stay the same size on screen.
- Colors come from `renderConfig.selectionColor`.
- The tags redraw on every interactive render, so they follow the mask while it is dragged (`selectedElementsAreBeingDragged`).

Draw rounded rectangles the same way `renderFrameHighlight` / `renderSelectionBorder` already do. Do not add new utilities.

## 4. Transform consistency

No change to the transform system. Dragging, resizing and rotating already change the mask's `x/y/width/height/angle`, and clipping is computed from those values at render time. Add tests to confirm it.

## Tests

New file: `packages/excalidraw/tests/maskTransform.test.tsx`. Reuse the setup helpers from `maskActions.test.tsx` and `maskGroup.test.tsx` (`API.createElement`, `Keyboard`, `UI`, and the PNG/SVG export helpers in `mask.test.tsx`).

**Mask mode**

- The toggle switches `maskMode`, the content element stays unchanged (same id and version), and the change can be undone and redone.
- SVG export of an outside mask uses `clip-rule="evenodd"` and an outer rectangle. An inside mask does not.
- PNG export: a pixel inside the mask is transparent and a pixel outside it is painted when the mode is outside. The reverse is true for inside (same pattern as the existing PNG test).
- `restore` keeps `"outside"` and drops invalid values.

**Mask all / none**

- Links every element that can be masked, and skips other masks, locked elements, images and bound text.
- None removes only this mask's links (other masks stay) and keeps the editor open.
- Both work from the masking-mode bar.

**Multiple masks:** an element linked to 3 masks (mixed inside and outside) produces 3 nested SVG groups.

**Transforms:** move the mask, then resize, rotate and toggle the mode, in sequence:

- `maskIds` stay the same and the content's x/y stay the same.
- After each step, the SVG clip transform matches the mask's new geometry.

**Tags:** spy on `fillText` of the interactive canvas context (or test a pure helper `getMaskTagTargets(appState, elementsMap)` and keep the rendering itself thin). Tags appear when the mask or a masked element is selected, and do not appear otherwise.

## Files

- `packages/element/src/types.ts`, `packages/element/src/mask.ts`
- `packages/excalidraw/renderer/maskClip.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/renderer/interactiveScene.ts`
- `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionMask.tsx`, `actions/index.ts`, `actions/types.ts`
- `packages/excalidraw/components/MaskEditToolbar.tsx` (+ `.scss`), `components/MaskingModeBar.tsx` (+ `.scss`)
- `packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json`
- New file: `packages/excalidraw/tests/maskTransform.test.tsx`

## Verification

- `yarn test:typecheck`
- `yarn vitest run packages/excalidraw/tests/mask` (all mask suites), then `yarn test:update` (snapshots may change for the new action names and the new appState-free element field).
- `yarn fix`
- Manual check with `yarn start`:
  1. Draw an ellipse and a rectangle.
  2. Press Ctrl+Alt+G and pick the rectangle.
  3. Double-click the mask twice to open the options, then toggle Inside/Outside.
  4. Use All and None.
  5. Drag, resize and rotate the mask, and check that the tags follow and the clipping stays correct.
  6. Export to PNG and SVG and compare.
```

```typescript
import { actionCancelMasking, actionMaskAll, actionMaskNone } from "../actions";
import { t } from "../i18n";

import { Island } from "./Island";

import "./MaskingModeBar.scss";

import type { ActionManager } from "../actions/manager";

/** shown at the bottom of the canvas while picking the element to mask */
export const MaskingModeBar = ({
  actionManager,
}: {
  actionManager: ActionManager;
}) => (
  <Island padding={1} className="masking-mode-bar">
    <span className="masking-mode-bar__hint">{t("labels.mask.picking")}</span>
    <button
      type="button"
      className="masking-mode-bar__button"
      data-testid="masking-mode-all"
      onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionMaskAll, "ui")}
    >
      {t("labels.mask.all")}
    </button>
    <button
      type="button"
      className="masking-mode-bar__button"
      data-testid="masking-mode-none"
      onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionMaskNone, "ui")}
    >
      {t("labels.mask.none")}
    </button>
    <button
      type="button"
      className="masking-mode-bar__button"
      data-testid="masking-mode-cancel"
      onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionCancelMasking, "ui")}
    >
      {t("buttons.cancel")}
    </button>
  </Island>
);
```

```typescript
import React from "react";
import { vi } from "vitest";

import { arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { CaptureUpdateAction, getMaskSvgPathData } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { Radians } from "@excalidraw/math";

import type { ExcalidrawMaskElement } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type {
  ExcalidrawElement,
  NonDeletedExcalidrawElement,
} from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import {
  actionEditMask,
  actionMaskAll,
  actionMaskNone,
  actionToggleMask,
  actionToggleMaskMode,
} from "../actions";
import { getDefaultAppState } from "../appState";
import { restoreElements } from "../data/restore";
import { Excalidraw } from "../index";
import { getMaskTags } from "../renderer/maskClip";
import { exportToCanvas, exportToSvg } from "../scene/export";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";
import { Keyboard, Pointer, UI } from "./helpers/ui";
import {
  act,
  fireEvent,
  GlobalTestState,
  render,
  screen,
  unmountComponent,
} from "./test-utils";

const { h } = window;

const mouse = new Pointer("mouse");

/**
 * mask: filled ellipse at (0, 0)–(100, 100)
 * target: filled rectangle at (50, 50)–(150, 150), clipped by the mask
 * other: unmasked rectangle at (300, 300)–(350, 350)
 */
const setup = (maskMode?: ExcalidrawElement["maskMode"]) => {
  const mask = {
    ...API.createElement({
      type: "ellipse",
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      width: 100,
      height: 100,
      backgroundColor: "#a5d8ff",
      fillStyle: "solid",
    }),
    maskEnabled: true,
    ...(maskMode ? { maskMode } : {}),
  };
  const target = {
    ...API.createElement({
      type: "rectangle",
      x: 50,
      y: 50,
      width: 100,
      height: 100,
      backgroundColor: "#ffc9c9",
      fillStyle: "solid",
    }),
    maskIds: [mask.id],
  };
  const other = API.createElement({
    type: "rectangle",
    x: 300,
    y: 300,
    width: 50,
    height: 50,
  });
  API.updateScene({
    elements: [mask, target, other],
    captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
  });
  return { mask, target, other };
};

/** opens the options of `mask` (selecting it) */
const openOptions = (mask: ExcalidrawElement) => {
  API.setSelectedElements([mask as NonDeletedExcalidrawElement]);
  act(() => {
    h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionEditMask, "api", mask.id);
  });
  expect(h.state.maskEditor?.mode).toBe("editing");
};

const exportSvg = (elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[]) =>
  exportToSvg(
    elements.filter((el) => !el.isDeleted) as NonDeletedExcalidrawElement[],
    { exportBackground: false, viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff" },
    null,
    { skipInliningFonts: true },
  );

const getClipPath = (
  svg: SVGSVGElement,
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  mask: ExcalidrawElement,
) => svg.querySelector(`#mask-clipPath-${element.id}-${mask.id} path`);

beforeEach(async () => {
  unmountComponent();
  mouse.reset();
  await render(<Excalidraw autoFocus={true} handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />);
  Object.assign(document, {
    elementFromPoint: () => GlobalTestState.canvas,
  });
});

describe("mask mode", () => {
  it("defaults to showing the inside", () => {
    const { mask } = setup();
    openOptions(mask);

    expect(API.getElement(mask).maskMode).toBeUndefined();
    expect(
      screen.getByTestId("mask-mode-inside").getAttribute("aria-checked"),
    ).toBe("true");
  });

  it("switches to the outside without recreating the mask or its content", () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup();
    const targetBefore = API.getElement(target);
    openOptions(mask);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("mask-mode-outside"));

    expect(API.getElement(mask).maskMode).toBe("outside");
    expect(API.getElement(mask).id).toBe(mask.id);
    expect(API.getElement(target)).toBe(targetBefore);
    expect(
      screen.getByTestId("mask-mode-outside").getAttribute("aria-checked"),
    ).toBe("true");
  });

  it("does nothing when picking the mode that's already on", () => {
    const { mask } = setup();
    openOptions(mask);
    const version = API.getElement(mask).version;

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("mask-mode-inside"));

    expect(API.getElement(mask).version).toBe(version);
  });

  it("can undo and redo switching the mode", () => {
    const { mask } = setup();
    openOptions(mask);

    API.executeAction(actionToggleMaskMode);
    expect(API.getElement(mask).maskMode).toBe("outside");

    Keyboard.undo();
    expect(API.getElement(mask).maskMode ?? "inside").toBe("inside");
    Keyboard.redo();
    expect(API.getElement(mask).maskMode).toBe("outside");
  });

  it("is kept when restoring, and invalid values are dropped", () => {
    const outside = {
      ...API.createElement({ type: "ellipse" }),
      maskMode: "outside" as const,
    };
    const invalid = {
      ...API.createElement({ type: "ellipse" }),
      maskMode: "sideways",
    } as unknown as ExcalidrawElement;

    const [restoredOutside, restoredInvalid] = restoreElements(
      [outside, invalid],
      null,
    );

    expect(restoredOutside.maskMode).toBe("outside");
    expect("maskMode" in restoredInvalid).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("mask mode export", () => {
  it("cuts the outline out of a surrounding rect in SVG", async () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup("outside");
    const svg = await exportSvg(h.elements);
    const path = getClipPath(svg, target, mask);

    expect(path?.getAttribute("clip-rule")).toBe("evenodd");
    // outer rect first, then the outline
    const d = path!.getAttribute("d")!;
    expect(d.match(/M/g)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(d.startsWith("M-")).toBe(true);
    expect(d.endsWith(getMaskSvgPathData(mask as ExcalidrawMaskElement))).toBe(
      true,
    );
  });

  it("uses the outline alone, with the default rule, for inside masks", async () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup("inside");
    const svg = await exportSvg(h.elements);
    const path = getClipPath(svg, target, mask);

    expect(path?.getAttribute("clip-rule")).toBe(null);
    expect(path?.getAttribute("d")).toBe(
      getMaskSvgPathData(mask as ExcalidrawMaskElement),
    );
  });

  it("makes the surrounding rect cover the whole masked element", () => {
    const mask = {
      ...API.createElement({
        type: "rectangle",
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        width: 10,
        height: 10,
      }),
      maskMode: "outside" as const,
    } as ExcalidrawMaskElement;
    const far = API.createElement({
      type: "rectangle",
      x: 500,
      y: 500,
      width: 100,
      height: 100,
    });
    const svgPath = getMaskSvgPathData(mask, Math.hypot(600 - 5, 600 - 5) + 1);
    const [, x, y] = /^M(-?[\d.]+) (-?[\d.]+)/.exec(svgPath)!.map(Number);
    expect(x).toBeLessThan(0);
    expect(y).toBeLessThan(0);
    expect(far.x + far.width).toBeLessThan(-x + mask.width);
  });

  it("clips the canvas with the even-odd rule for outside masks", async () => {
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
    const clip = vi.spyOn(context, "clip");
    const { mask, target } = setup("outside");

    await exportToCanvas(
      [mask, target] as NonDeletedExcalidrawElement[],
      {
        ...getDefaultAppState(),
        width: 0,
        height: 0,
        offsetTop: 0,
        offsetLeft: 0,
        exportScale: 1,
      },
      {},
      { exportBackground: false, viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff" },
      (width, height) => {
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        return { canvas, scale: 1 };
      },
    );

    expect(clip.mock.calls).toEqual([["evenodd"]]);
  });
});

describe("mask all / mask none", () => {
  it("masks every element that can be masked", () => {
    const { mask, target, other } = setup();
    const locked = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", locked: true });
    const image = API.createElement({ type: "image" });
    const otherMask = API.createElement({ type: "diamond" });
    const otherMasked = {
      ...API.createElement({ type: "rectangle" }),
      maskIds: [otherMask.id],
    };
    API.updateScene({
      elements: [...h.elements, locked, image, otherMask, otherMasked],
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });
    openOptions(mask);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("mask-all"));

    expect(API.getElement(target).maskIds).toEqual([mask.id]);
    expect(API.getElement(other).maskIds).toEqual([mask.id]);
    expect(API.getElement(otherMasked).maskIds).toEqual([
      otherMask.id,
      mask.id,
    ]);
    expect(API.getElement(locked).maskIds).toBeUndefined();
    expect(API.getElement(image).maskIds).toBeUndefined();
    // other masks never become masked
    expect(API.getElement(otherMask).maskIds).toBeUndefined();
    expect(h.state.maskEditor?.mode).toBe("editing");
  });

  it("unmasks every element of the mask, keeping their other masks", () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup();
    const otherMask = API.createElement({ type: "diamond" });
    const both = {
      ...API.createElement({ type: "rectangle" }),
      maskIds: [mask.id, otherMask.id],
    };
    API.updateScene({
      elements: [...h.elements, otherMask, both],
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });
    openOptions(mask);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("mask-none"));

    expect(API.getElement(target).maskIds).toBe(null);
    expect(API.getElement(both).maskIds).toEqual([otherMask.id]);
    // the options stay open to pick again
    expect(h.state.maskEditor).toEqual({ maskId: mask.id, mode: "editing" });
  });

  it("works from the masking-mode bar", () => {
    const shape = API.createElement({ type: "ellipse" });
    const a = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", x: 200 });
    const b = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", x: 400 });
    API.updateScene({
      elements: [shape, a, b],
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });
    API.setSelectedElements([shape]);
    API.executeAction(actionToggleMask);
    expect(h.state.maskEditor?.mode).toBe("picking");

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("masking-mode-all"));
    expect(API.getElement(a).maskIds).toEqual([shape.id]);
    expect(API.getElement(b).maskIds).toEqual([shape.id]);
    expect(API.getElement(shape).maskEnabled).toBe(true);
    expect(h.state.maskEditor?.mode).toBe("picking");

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("masking-mode-none"));
    expect(API.getElement(a).maskIds).toBe(null);
    expect(API.getElement(b).maskIds).toBe(null);
    expect(h.state.maskEditor?.mode).toBe("picking");
  });

  it("can undo mask all", () => {
    const { mask, other } = setup();
    openOptions(mask);

    API.executeAction(actionMaskAll);
    expect(API.getElement(other).maskIds).toEqual([mask.id]);

    Keyboard.undo();
    expect(API.getElement(other).maskIds).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("does nothing without an open mask editor", () => {
    const { other } = setup();

    API.executeAction(actionMaskAll);
    API.executeAction(actionMaskNone);

    expect(API.getElement(other).maskIds).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe("multiple masks", () => {
  it("clips an element by three masks with mixed modes", async () => {
    const masks = [
      API.createElement({ type: "ellipse" }),
      { ...API.createElement({ type: "rectangle" }), maskMode: "outside" },
      API.createElement({ type: "triangle" }),
    ] as ExcalidrawElement[];
    const masked = {
      ...API.createElement({ type: "rectangle" }),
      maskIds: masks.map((mask) => mask.id),
    };
    const svg = await exportSvg([...masks, masked]);

    let parent: Element | null = svg;
    for (const mask of masks) {
      parent = parent!.querySelector(
        `g[clip-path="url(#mask-clipPath-${masked.id}-${mask.id})"]`,
      );
      expect(parent).not.toBe(null);
    }
    expect(parent!.querySelector(`[data-id="${masked.id}"]`)).not.toBe(null);
    expect(getClipPath(svg, masked, masks[1])?.getAttribute("clip-rule")).toBe(
      "evenodd",
    );
  });
});

describe("transforming a mask on its own", () => {
  it("keeps the relationship and follows the mask through every transformation", async () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup();
    const targetBefore = API.getElement(target);
    const clipTransform = async () =>
      getClipPath(await exportSvg(h.elements), target, mask)!.getAttribute(
        "transform",
      );

    // move: drag the mask by its fill, away from the target
    mouse.downAt(20, 50);
    mouse.moveTo(-80, -50);
    mouse.up();
    expect(API.getElement(mask).x).toBe(-100);
    expect(API.getElement(mask).y).toBe(-100);
    expect(await clipTransform()).toContain("translate(-50 -50)");

    // resize
    UI.resize(API.getElement(mask), "se", [50, 50]);
    expect(API.getElement(mask).width).toBe(150);
    expect(await clipTransform()).toContain("translate(-25 -25)");

    // rotate
    UI.rotate(API.getElement(mask), [100, 100]);
    const { angle } = API.getElement(mask);
    expect(angle).not.toBe(0);
    expect(await clipTransform()).toContain(
      `rotate(${(180 * angle) / Math.PI})`,
    );

    // change the mode
    openOptions(mask);
    API.executeAction(actionToggleMaskMode);
    const svg = await exportSvg(h.elements);
    expect(getClipPath(svg, target, mask)?.getAttribute("clip-rule")).toBe(
      "evenodd",
    );
    expect(getClipPath(svg, target, mask)?.getAttribute("transform")).toContain(
      `rotate(${(180 * angle) / Math.PI})`,
    );

    // the content is untouched and still linked
    expect(API.getElement(target)).toBe(targetBefore);
    expect(API.getElement(target).maskIds).toEqual([mask.id]);
  });
});

describe("parent/child tags", () => {
  const tagsFor = (
    selected: ExcalidrawElement[],
    maskEditor: { maskId: string } | null = null,
  ) =>
    getMaskTags(
      {
        selectedElementIds: Object.fromEntries(
          selected.map((el) => [el.id, true as const]),
        ),
        maskEditor,
      },
      arrayToMap(h.elements),
    ).map((tag) => ({ kind: tag.kind, id: tag.element.id, count: tag.count }));

  it("tags a selected mask and its elements", () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup();

    expect(tagsFor([mask])).toEqual([
      { kind: "mask", id: mask.id, count: 1 },
      { kind: "masked", id: target.id, count: 1 },
    ]);
  });

  it("tags the masks of a selected masked element", () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup();

    expect(tagsFor([target])).toEqual([
      { kind: "mask", id: mask.id, count: 1 },
      { kind: "masked", id: target.id, count: 1 },
    ]);
  });

  it("tags the mask being picked for, even before it has elements", () => {
    const shape = API.createElement({ type: "ellipse" });
    API.updateScene({
      elements: [shape],
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });

    expect(tagsFor([], { maskId: shape.id })).toEqual([
      { kind: "mask", id: shape.id, count: 0 },
    ]);
  });

  it("counts every mask of an element, tagging it once", () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup();
    const second = API.createElement({ type: "diamond" });
    API.updateScene({
      elements: [
        ...h.elements.map((el) =>
          el.id === target.id ? { ...el, maskIds: [mask.id, second.id] } : el,
        ),
        second,
      ],
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });

    expect(tagsFor([mask, second])).toEqual([
      { kind: "mask", id: mask.id, count: 1 },
      { kind: "masked", id: target.id, count: 2 },
      { kind: "mask", id: second.id, count: 1 },
    ]);
  });

  it("shows no tags for unrelated selections", () => {
    const { other } = setup();

    expect(tagsFor([other])).toEqual([]);
    expect(tagsFor([])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("marks outside masks", () => {
    const { mask } = setup("outside");
    const [maskTag] = getMaskTags(
      { selectedElementIds: { [mask.id]: true }, maskEditor: null },
      arrayToMap(h.elements),
    );

    expect(maskTag).toMatchObject({ kind: "mask", isOutside: true });
  });

  it("draws the tags without changing the selection or the scene", () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup();
    const before = h.elements;
    API.setSelectedElements([mask]);
    expect(h.elements).toBe(before);
    expect(API.getElement(target).maskIds).toEqual([mask.id]);
  });
});

describe("rotated outside masks", () => {
  it("rotates the cut-out with the mask", async () => {
    const { mask, target } = setup("outside");
    API.updateElement(mask, { angle: (Math.PI / 4) as Radians });
    const svg = await exportSvg(h.elements);

    expect(getClipPath(svg, target, mask)?.getAttribute("transform")).toContain(
      "rotate(45)",
    );
  });
});
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 19:44:42Z)**_

Issue 73 is implemented on `feat/issue-73-mask-transform`, but nothing is committed yet. Typecheck passes and the full suite passes (2130 tests). I haven't run it in a browser, so the new buttons and the canvas tags haven't been seen on screen yet.

**What's new, by acceptance criterion:**

- **Inside/outside visibility:** a mask can now be set to show its content inside or outside its outline. An "outside" mask cuts its shape out of the content, in the editor and in PNG/SVG export. Old drawings without the setting stay "inside".
- **Mode changes without recreating anything:** an Inside | Outside toggle in the mask options toolbar changes only the mask. The masked content is untouched, and the change can be undone.
- **Parent/child tags:** small labels drawn on the canvas, never exported. The mask gets a filled "Mask · N" label (N = how many elements it masks, with "(outside)" when that mode is on). Each masked element gets an outlined "Masked" label, or "Masked ×k" if it has several masks. They show when a mask is selected or being dragged, while picking elements for a mask, or when a masked element is selected.
- **Mask all / Mask none:** buttons in both the mask options toolbar and the bar shown while picking. "All" links every element that can be masked; "None" removes every link to that mask and leaves the toolbar or picking open. Both can be undone.
- **Multiple masks:** already supported, with no cap as you chose. The new tests cover one element with 3 masks in mixed modes.
- **Consistency after transforms:** one test moves, resizes and rotates a mask, switches its mode, then moves it again. After each step it checks that the exported clip matches the mask's new position and the content stays the same and still linked.

**Things you should know:**

- **The tags are only partly tested.** The tests check which elements get tags and what they say, not the actual drawing. Worth a quick look in the app.
- **There's a second copy of the repo inside this folder.** `.tmp-ai-logs-wt/` is another git worktree on `misc/sprint-1-ai-logs`. The repo-wide `yarn fix` and `yarn test:update` would also rewrite its files and update its snapshots, and 3 of its export tests already fail. So I ran Prettier and ESLint on just my changed files and ran the tests with that folder excluded. You may want to remove the worktree (`git worktree remove .tmp-ai-logs-wt`) before running those scripts.

Most of the change is in `packages/element/src/mask.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/renderer/maskClip.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionMask.tsx` and `packages/excalidraw/renderer/interactiveScene.ts`. The new tests are in `packages/excalidraw/tests/maskTransform.test.tsx`.

To try it with `yarn start`: draw a filled ellipse over a rectangle, select the ellipse, press Ctrl+Alt+G and double-click the rectangle. Then double-click the ellipse twice to open its options, toggle Inside/Outside, and try All and None.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 20:01:03Z)**_

Use the **Inside | Outside** toggle in the mask options toolbar:

1. **Make a mask, if you don't have one yet.** Select a shape (rectangle, ellipse, diamond or triangle) and press **Ctrl+Alt+G**. Double-click the element(s) you want masked, then double-click empty canvas or press Escape to finish picking.
2. **Open the mask options.** Double-click the mask shape **twice**. The first double-click opens its text editor, which is existing behavior. Click away or press Escape to close it, then double-click the mask again. A small toolbar appears next to the mask's top-right corner.
3. **Pick a mode.** Click **Show outside** to hide the content inside the mask's outline and show everything around it. Click **Show inside** to go back to the default. The highlighted button is the current mode.

The change can be undone with Ctrl+Z, and the "Mask · N" tag above the mask shows "(outside)" while that mode is on.

There's no keyboard shortcut for this, and it isn't in the command palette. The toolbar is the only way to switch. I can add a shortcut or a command palette entry if you'd like.

```typescript
import clsx from "clsx";

import { getMaskMode } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { actionToggleMaskMode } from "../actions";
import { t } from "../i18n";

import { useExcalidrawActionManager } from "./App";

import "./MaskModeToggle.scss";

/**
 * Show inside | Show outside, for the mask being edited or picked for. Shared
 * by the mask options and the masking-mode bar.
 */
export const MaskModeToggle = ({ mask }: { mask: ExcalidrawElement }) => {
  const actionManager = useExcalidrawActionManager();
  const maskMode = getMaskMode(mask);

  return (
    <div className="mask-mode-toggle" role="radiogroup">
      {(["inside", "outside"] as const).map((mode) => (
        <button
          key={mode}
          type="button"
          role="radio"
          aria-checked={maskMode === mode}
          className={clsx("mask-mode-toggle__button", {
            "mask-mode-toggle__button--active": maskMode === mode,
          })}
          data-testid={`mask-mode-${mode}`}
          onClick={() =>
            maskMode !== mode &&
            actionManager.executeAction(actionToggleMaskMode, "ui")
          }
        >
          {t(
            mode === "inside"
              ? "labels.mask.showInside"
              : "labels.mask.showOutside",
          )}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};
```

```scss
// same look as `.mask-edit-toolbar__button`, joined into one control
.excalidraw {
  .mask-mode-toggle {
    display: flex;

    height: 1.75rem;
    padding: 0 0.625rem;

    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--text-primary-color);
    white-space: nowrap;

    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--default-border-color);
    border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;

    &:hover {
      background: var(--button-hover-bg);

  }
}
```

```typescript
import { actionCancelMasking, actionMaskAll, actionMaskNone } from "../actions";
import { getEditedMask } from "../actions/actionMask";
import { t } from "../i18n";

import { useExcalidrawAppState, useExcalidrawElements } from "./App";
import { Island } from "./Island";
import { MaskModeToggle } from "./MaskModeToggle";

import "./MaskingModeBar.scss";

import type { ActionManager } from "../actions/manager";

/** shown at the bottom of the canvas while picking the element to mask */
export const MaskingModeBar = ({
  actionManager,
}: {
  actionManager: ActionManager;
}) => {
  const appState = useExcalidrawAppState();
  const elements = useExcalidrawElements();
  const mask = getEditedMask(elements, appState);

  return (
    <Island padding={1} className="masking-mode-bar">
      <span className="masking-mode-bar__hint">{t("labels.mask.picking")}</span>
      {mask && <MaskModeToggle mask={mask} />}
      <button
        type="button"
        className="masking-mode-bar__button"
        data-testid="masking-mode-all"
        onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionMaskAll, "ui")}
      >
        {t("labels.mask.all")}
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="masking-mode-bar__button"
        data-testid="masking-mode-none"
        onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionMaskNone, "ui")}
      >
        {t("labels.mask.none")}
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="masking-mode-bar__button"
        data-testid="masking-mode-cancel"
        onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionCancelMasking, "ui")}
      >
        {t("buttons.cancel")}
      </button>
    </Island>
  );
};
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 20:36:41Z)**_

Both changes are in. Typecheck and lint pass, and all 26 tests in `maskTransform.test.tsx` pass. Nothing is committed yet.

**Inside/Outside while picking:** the bar shown while you're picking elements for a new mask now has the same **Show inside | Show outside** toggle as the mask options toolbar. You can set the mode before picking anything, and it stays set once you pick. Both places use one shared component, `components/MaskModeToggle.tsx`.

**Numbered tags:**

- **Masks are numbered "Mask 1", "Mask 2", … in scene (stacking) order.** The numbering covers every mask in the drawing, so a mask keeps its number whichever one you select. Outside masks read "Mask 2 (outside)".
- **Each mask's elements are numbered in scene order too:** "Mask 1 Child 1", "Mask 1 Child 2", …
- **An element with several masks gets one tag per mask,** stacked upwards above it, e.g. "Mask 1 Child 2" and "Mask 2 Child 1".
- **Numbers shift when masks or links change.** If Mask 1 is removed, the old Mask 2 becomes Mask 1. A shape you're currently picking for gets a number straight away, even before it has any elements.
- **I made one call you may want changed:** when you select Mask 1 and one of its children also belongs to Mask 2, the "Mask 2" label also appears so you can see which shape that is. Mask 2's other children don't get tags.

**Test runs:** the full-suite run took over 10 minutes and had 3 failures in unrelated history, scroll and linear-element tests. A re-run of just those three suites here passed (117 tests), and they failed on different tests from run to run, so it looks like timing flakiness on a busy machine.

That run also overwrote the history snapshot with bad data: it captured the app before it had finished loading. I restored it from git, so no snapshot files are changed. I haven't re-run the entire suite since restoring it.

As before, I haven't looked at any of this in a browser yet. The tag tests check the label text and positions-to-element mapping, not the drawing itself.
